content:
Posted this on Linkedin, so thought I would also post it here:

As a side-quest to something else, I made a version of Physlib docs which you can edit the documentation 'wikipedia' style. The edit then becomes an issue posted to Physlib. (Currently only works on a web browser, not on a mobile). See e.g.

https://jstoobysmith.github.io/PhyslibVerso/Physlib/SpaceAndTime/Space/EuclideanGroup/Action/
If anyone knows where it might be worth sharing the above, to potentially increase engagement with it, I would be very interested.
